### 2026-10-06 – ## First entry, but I did do a looot!!

**5h**

## First entry, but I did do a looot!!
> TL;DR: Got the idea, defined the components, and started on the MCU and power modules.
---
So first things first was to find an idea on what to make, after a while of thinking and researching, I decided to make a two piece PCB, where on half get hung on a persons neck as a pendant, and one as a bracelet that goes around the wrist. The pendant half has addressable LEDs, which show the persons heartbeat, its also rechargeable via an internal battery and a USB C port. The bracelet half has a pulse sensor, some status LEDs, and also an internal battery with a USB C port. The port is also used to initially program the ESP32-C3-MINI-1-H4X's, which communicate with each other via the ESP-NOW protocol. The PCB(s) also have a 3v3 voltage regulator (AP2112K-3.3), a USB esd protection (USBLC6-2SC6), and a LiPo charge controller (MCP73831). And to obviously know how to connect everything, I had to look through each of the ICs typical application diagrams.

![Screenshot_20261006_205315](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/d6a83b37ad576cbb250f01c29116f7fb15b54f60b1f2b2acb696fb0d0f9a805b.png)

![Screenshot_20261006_205311](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/e6f514ff8e94815efc9ab6c94d15ba7875ebd31be6a4aa3c3368c0625a82b573.png)

![Screenshot_20261006_205305](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/c77f3682b7559ba662238db6b172610d9a1cd509d865cb31320a85d336c1404d.png)

![Screenshot_20261006_205252](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/6f40d1c4581d3f7034d6ff847aa9dceef72f44dcd9d70378697cfa99db6e3563.png)

To be honest I forgot to take screenshot when I was making it, but I did run into some issues with the ERC (Electric Rules Check) which was complaining about power pins not having sources, but I found out that it could actually be easily fixed using PWR_FLAG. But that was it so far, here's the current schematic:

![output_page-0001](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/d3721f5db23be0b12542a23162322bcf12762b1a86f1fe3690396cd1b35fde2d.jpg)

That's it so far, for tomorrow I'll probably work on the actual pulse sensor, and format everything better.

### 2026-10-07 – ## Finished the bracelet, and started on Pendant :)

**9h**

## Finished the bracelet, and started on Pendant :)
> TL;DR: Finished working on the bracelet by adding the pulse sensor as a custom symbol, And started on the Pendant, Added LEDs.
---
First, I ran the ERC to make sure everything was working, had some warnings but nothing major, then I looked for the pulse sensor that I was going to use, and found an I2C breakout board that could soldered on top of the bracelet PCB.

![MAX30102-Module-Capteur-dOxygene-et-rythme-cardiaque-agadir-scaled](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/539b625a44fa8dba56f5fda3ecb5ecda913079670a2eef0786cd5f79c49a96a7.png)

Once I got that sorted, I searched if there was a pre-made symbol & footprint already made, and I couldn't find anything for the module I decided to use, So I had to make a custom one, which isn't hard. I only made the symbol (for now) but I will add the footprint later.

![Screenshot_20261007_150108](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/dc3287edd608203c9d597bdfae9afda1bf2ec54f0a0ea2e02ac255c268f0a948.png)

Then I looked for a youtube video of how it usually wired, and used that to make the schematic for mine.

![Screenshot_20261007_150126](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/ed8764a5ef83fceb0a72587683fd60cdb723363895ddc89a4097477347254e7e.png)

After that was done, basically the bracelet schematic half was done. Next I added a new sheet for the pendant. And I basically just copied the MCU, USB C, and power management parts of the bracelet over.

![Screenshot_20261007_162416](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/314520b4fe416b3389c370f2e2bc3dfaeaa8e6243fc573e083ed5988adfe7914.png)

Next I picked the addressable led modules that I was going to use, I first considered using a seperate module, but then later setteled on just getting the raw led, after searching, I found SK6812 MINI-E, which are RBG Addressable LEDs, which is perfect, it even allowed me to show different colors when for example the pendant is charging and stuff.

![Screenshot_20261007_202945](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/892712bafd284a2751d4e119312ee388b4f26f3896929f1fcd9d21d7713f0fac.png)

Then I had to add a mosfet transistor because even when the LEDs are off, they still consume energy which will drain the battery, I found a design and just to be honest copied it. It uses two transistors, which basically make sure the full voltage goes through. I used 2N7002 and A03401A.

![Screenshot_20261007_202645](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/26507218223d1ce3c024eec16681c3e50b00ddc968fabbaef7cb97a35a11e912.png)

![Screenshot_20261007_202848](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/51d3ece9d0dba9e0b4df07e7b677a05f49d1a199f897fb8420d71ead5ed00b41.png)

Then I first started by implementing the two part power management part.

![Screenshot_20261007_203724](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/e1fae38df94dfadba23f1cb2ea02a9ebd6e1a3ddbf89b49ea5c8221ae5d1cb18.png)

Then added the LEDs, also adding a current limiting resistor and 100nF capacitors from the LED voltage to ground. And that was it.

![Screenshot_20261007_201535](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/3dfa9d8aeb6d612565ced957093a1908ff98321fcdc07991578a9231f2177790.png)

### 2026-10-08 – ## I actually locked in today

**11h**

## I actually locked in today
> 11 hours of continious tedious pcb designing.
---
So first I started by designing a custom footprint for the MAX30102 module that I was gonna use.

![Screenshot_20261008_181807](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/5ba9abff82f5879dfe59899297c554aa3c7ce25cf903a67a1b5cb271e75eb25e.png)

Then I took those measurements and also found the pin spacing which was standard 2.54 mm. Suprisingly, a Aliexpress listing for the exact same module was what helped me actually figure all this out.

![Screenshot_20261009_005531](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/4f84219f10d1d5089d8f0453b24cefe2d13c8af790806aab78e1748718395598.png)

Then I started working on it on KiCad. It was pretty easy, and I decided to solder the module as a SMD component, because it has side pins that were compatible with SMD. I added the pins and some text for each pin.

![Screenshot_20261008_181756](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/9a284b106fca05aa080cfe7631b2c2c3355f11bb852c40b067b6c126437382d6.png)

After that was done, I assigned the footprint to the symbol, and switched to PCB mode, and update the PCB from schematic which basically transfered all the components over to the PCB mode.

![Screenshot_20261008_192650](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/a8932b0acf3eac589bb5a490354acf45ce3ea07121ff7807af692c0152c5a35f.png)

Once that was done, I started by grouping each component close to where it needed to be. And separating the Pendant and Bracelet sides.

![Screenshot_20261008_192701](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/20983c75c7f4a36a9c059f8602c85de808da678aa297a7010518e8fa86075707.png)

And also started grouping and formating the Pendant too, It was a little bit difficult but still doable.

![Screenshot_20261008_194548](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/724c9649275c9ae18bb24ba0e8c760180c8f54d3761a57dac1c070474f9ab318.png)

Then I had to design the actual board layout so that I can figure out where each component goes, So I just used Figma to design the board shape, export it as a SVG, then convert it to DXF which then can be imported into KiCad and used as Edge Cut layer.

![Screenshot_20261009_010316](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/2ce7486158f6c5847d2d25d67c9e33e8e60fd2245bb9a7d87dd6b8df1c38f1ce.png)

Once that was done, I imported it, scaled it, and started laying out the components inside, deciding where each component went, and where the USB C was facing, etc.

![Screenshot_20261008_221038](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/be11b0d814ccbed5d2b5f7a3d87cdbc7fb93818e272702186d88ec284b666e4c.png)

Then layed everything out, made sure nothing was intersecting.

![Screenshot_20261008_222745](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/5e08f89b2894c285698c27c2e90ffe30a4022936e32cf32db3d653be1c932ec6.png)

Then next was the Bracelet half, did the same thing.

![Screenshot_20261008_223738](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/42b65fb974f58c78e5caa250e8cc4412493de14cf8ba5ad83d3f07422f3643fb.png)

Next was adding the ground plan fill in, which was easy, they had to be seperate for each side, I also added keep-out areas where the ESP32 antennas were (I forgot the Pendant half, but I will fix it tomorrow).

![Screenshot_20261008_225245](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/1dfccb4fd440fc64bbc035dce7a9fb982fe6b01596d7022b5eb581901502325e.png)

Next came the routing, I decided to only do the Bracelet half for this day, and leave the other half for tomorrow, I was somewhat confusing at first, but I got it done (even tho to be honest it looks shii :) ).

![Screenshot_20261008_233337](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/45e332f2cc868c5d87e41dba7d5c5aee1ba2b08ce6d42fe0a07882ff955a708b.png)

Next things are probably route the Pendant half, BOM, drill files , gerber, Pick and Place (for the assembly), get the JLCPCB quote, and finally the actual code.
